grid=[[0]*N for _ in range(N)]
def put(points,color,dr,dc):
    for r,c in points:
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        assert 0<=rr<N and 0<=cc<N,(color,rr,cc)
        if grid[rr][cc] not in (0,color): print('collision',rr,cc,grid[rr][cc],color)
        grid[rr][cc]=color
